js: (async()=>{const st=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8896/api/interactive/boards/board_default/state')).json();const live=st.state.cards.filter(c=>!c.deleted&&c.kind!=='reply');const src=live[0],dst=live[1];const el=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+src.id+'"]');const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const sx=r.x+20,sy=r.y+20;el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',{bubbles:true,clientX:sx,clientY:sy,pointerId:3,buttons:1}));const target=document.querySelector('[data-card-id="'+dst.id+'"]').getBoundingClientRect();const tx=target.x+target.width/2,ty=target.y+target.height/2;for(let i=1;i<=8;i++){window.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,clientX:sx+(tx-sx)*i/8,clientY:sy+(ty-sy)*i/8,pointerId:3,buttons:1}))}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400));return JSON.stringify({hint:(document.body.innerText.match(/松开后合并成组/)||['（没有提示）'])[0],src:dst.id})})()
